candidate_universe.definition: union of complete_manifest.csv and excluded_races.csv for every batch frozen in the research_v0 dataset manifest
prediction_requirements: official program contains exactly lanes 1 through 6
every program entry has racer, motor, and boat identity
beforeinfo parses to exactly lanes 1 through 6
required exhibition and weather fields are present

outcome_policy.unique_order: official result has one lane at each of places 1, 2, and 3, all six finish ranks are the permutation 1 through 6, and the raw trifecta payout confirms that ordered top three
outcome_policy.unique_top3_abnormal: official result has one lane at each of places 1, 2, and 3 and the raw trifecta payout confirms that order, while at least one remaining finish code is non-standard (for example F/refund/disqualification)
outcome_policy.tied: official result or trifecta payout represents more than one winning ordered top-three combination
outcome_policy.void: no uniquely confirmed ordered top-three target
outcome_policy.main_one_hot_rule: prediction eligible and either unique_order or unique_top3_abnormal with exactly one matching official raw trifecta payout

coverage_definitions.scorable_to_prediction_artifact_rate: scorable race_keys present as valid rows in the prediction artifact / scorable

unique_required_equalities: top3_targets first/second/third equals official raw result places 1/2/3
official raw trifecta payout contains exactly that ordered combination
target_reconciliation.tied_policy: retain all official winning combinations separately; never assign one class_id

feature_availability.prediction_cutoff: after official beforeinfo is available and strictly before closed_at
feature_availability.provider_aggregate_limitation: the upstream calculation windows behind published national, local, motor, and boat percentages are not present in the raw schema and therefore cannot be independently reconstructed by this audit

diagnostics.oracle_unscorable_fallback: uniform solely to satisfy full prediction coverage; these rows are not scored
